# Sync Contract & Concurrency Checklist: Sync Follow-ups

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of the heads read, `sync_position`, the rename re-stamp and the restore pair (depth: standard; audience: PR reviewer)
**Created**: 2026-10-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is the exact membership set the heads read lists (active memberships, live wallets, archived included) stated in one place and repeated identically in the contract? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, sync.yaml]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the meaning of `sync_position` defined for every page kind — first page, intermediate page, last page, empty page, cursorless read? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the client's comparison rules (equal, greater, purged above, unlisted, no stored position) all documented in the contract? [Completeness, Spec §US1, contracts/sync-follow-ups-api.md]
- [ ] CHK004 Is it specified which row columns a re-stamp changes and which it must leave untouched? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements defined for a failed or interrupted re-stamp run (retry, partial progress)? [Gap, Exception Flow, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the scope of the restore promise limited explicitly to the record types the batch can restore? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK007 Are documentation follow-ups (constitution ADR lines, api-conventions, B15 inherited note) captured as requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019, plan R-11]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK008 Is "scope head" defined precisely enough (counter value as committed at read time) to decide equality without ambiguity? [Clarity, Spec §Key Entities, glossary]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "bounded for people in many wallets" quantified (per-run limit, locks held per unit of work)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "coalesce renames whose work has not started" defined so that a rename committing during a running re-stamp is never lost? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK011 Is it clear whether archived wallets are re-stamped on a rename? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, §FR-010]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 Do the spec, `sync.yaml` and the glossary define `sync_position` with the same wording (feed position of the last row, not the record's `change_seq`, for transfers into a wallet)? [Consistency, glossary Sync Position, sync.yaml ChangeFeedMeta]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the "same `version`, apply equal versions" behaviour of a re-sent membership consistent with ADR-0008's "keep the highest version" guidance on the feeds? [Consistency, sync.yaml user feed, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK014 Does ADR-0021 align with ADR-0017 rule 5 (lock order) and the spec's "no user-row lock" rule? [Consistency, ADR-0021, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK015 Are the heads read's refusals identical to the feeds' collection refusals (filter, sort, limit, cursor)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, §5 API]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK016 Can SC-002 (300 ms p95 for 200 wallets) and SC-003 (60 s propagation) be measured with stated conditions (Xdebug off, running worker)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK017 Does every invariant in §4 name a test that fails when it is broken? [Measurability, Spec §4]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK018 Are concurrent-write races (write committing between heads read and feed read; between counter read and wallet row read) addressed? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK019 Are rename races with removal, leaving and wallet deletion addressed? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the queue-down behaviour stated, including what partners see meanwhile? [Coverage, Recovery, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the restore + upsert pair's failure path (restore refused) fully specified for each refusal kind? [Coverage, Spec §US3 #3]
- [ ] CHK022 Are callers in zero wallets and in more than one page of wallets covered? [Coverage, Edge Case, Gap]

## Non-Functional (Security, Privacy, Observability)

- [ ] CHK023 Is it stated that the heads read reveals nothing about wallets the caller does not belong to, and carries no record content? [Security, Spec §FR-006, §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK024 Are log contents for the heads read and the re-stamp run restricted (no names, positions or ids at info)? [Privacy, Spec §FR-017]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK025 Is the assumption "the wallet row always sits at the scope head" validated against how the counter is implemented? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, research R-2]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the client's equal-version apply rule recorded as a dependency for the name re-send to take effect? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Gaps found when this checklist was generated and fixed in the spec on 2026-10-02 (owner away, delegated authority): CHK005 (FR-020 retry and partial progress), CHK006 (FR-014 limited to transactions), CHK007 (FR-021 documentation), CHK011 (FR-007 archived wallets included), CHK013 (FR-008 equal-version wording), CHK022 (edge cases for zero wallets and several pages), CHK026 (assumption on the client's equal-version rule).
